policy: Simulate plausible visual process mechanisms for design judgment. Values are Blender/design estimates, not supplier specifications or evidence claims.

profiles.name: Fine Matte Powder-Coated Metal Visual Hypothesis
profiles.rule: opaque dielectric coat visual mechanism; narrow roughness modulation; weak bump; reject chrome, visible grain and exaggerated orange peel
profiles.claim_boundary: Does not assert that the target project uses powder coating.

profiles.name: Injection-Molded PP Fine Matte Visual Hypothesis
profiles.rule: roughness-led microstructure; subtle bump; avoid visible Noise in Base Color
profiles.claim_boundary: Does not establish project finish texture or molding surface specification.

profiles.name: PU Soft Matte Contact Surface Visual Hypothesis
profiles.rule: broader reflection; microstructure subordinate to geometry; avoid rubber caricature
profiles.claim_boundary: Does not establish exact PU family, process or production finish.

profiles.name: Brushed / Anodized Aluminum Visual Hypothesis
profiles.rule: tangent direction primary; Wave/Gabor only low-amplitude perturbation; no visible stripes
profiles.claim_boundary: Does not establish alloy, anodizing process or supplier finish.

profiles.name: Milky Transmissive Diffuser Visual Hypothesis
profiles.rule: preserve Fresnel edge and thickness; visually tune scatter; avoid clear glass and flat emission-card reading
profiles.claim_boundary: Does not establish optical transmission, haze, material grade or production specification.
